config.label: CUC FY2025 reported grid work

manifestSource.locator: PDF4 / printed4, power generation/T&D/renewables section, all 26 top-level bullets

config.geographicScope: Saipan, Tinian and Rota source context within the Northern Mariana Islands; no territory-wide project census.
config.inventoryScope: Twenty-six power-work bullets on printed page4; eight useful contextual grid entries retained and eighteen generation, completed, operating, civil, vehicle or broad-study entries excluded. Page2 supplements the same entries.
limitations: These are bounded public contextual inventories, not complete CNMI planned-transmission coverage or distinct engineering-project counts.
All service/need dates and construction windows are unknown. Fiscal budgets and model assumptions do not supply event dates.
Publisher, operator and existing-network ownership do not establish row-specific ownership of proposed assets.
No native project coordinates, CRS or accuracy were qualified. Island/terminal text and modeled lengths do not supply centers.
A public asset-level implementation register with adopted work, current lifecycle and geographic evidence remains missing.
Named physical bullets6/8/16/17/18 are capital-project-context; broad bullets5/19/20 remain planning-context. None is transmission-qualified.
Four retained entries are planned; four retain unknown lifecycle. Design completion, a funding award or procurement does not establish construction approval.
Tinian/Rota bullet16 and multi-island programs remain single source entries without invented child assets.
The publication and lifecycle evidence is October2025; no publication day or service milestone is invented.
